rules: Every attack requires injection_hit_count exactly one and the registered mechanism-specific observation.
Zero or multiple hits make every attack NOT_RUN; natural exit invalidates only a process-fault cell that expected forced termination.
Action A must have durable evidence and be complete while action B is proven not run.
Recoverable infrastructure faults must reach the registered bounded state without businessless terminal FAILED.
Only the preregistered bad-payload, policy-rejection, explicit-cancellation, and retry-budget-exhaustion reasons may terminate FAILED; each reason must be exact and unique.
Matched benign controls use catalog_hit_count one and never carry an injection marker.
No fixture or unexecuted catalog establishes production reliability or a quality result.
